decision.rationale: The dispute was opened on 2026-10-27, 24 days after TXN-007929 posted on 2026-10-03. That is within the 120-day limit. TXN-007929 posted 198780 minor units (1987.80 EUR) at Silverbirch Travel (MER-000007, TRAVEL). Its authorisation AUTH-008135 was approved for the same 198780 minor units, ECOMMERCE, with 3-D Secure authenticated. No receipt or quote is attached. The cardholder's figure of 1769.15 EUR is a claim, not a merchant document, so no agreed amount has been shown and no difference can yet be calculated against the claimed 218.65 EUR. Under amount-no-receipt, when there is no receipt and the posted amount equals the authorised amount, the merchant must be asked for the receipt or order details.

proposed_actions.note: For the card purchase of 1987.80 EUR on 2026-10-02, please send the receipt or order details, including the quote, showing the amount the cardholder agreed to pay.
